name: Floating / offshore solar PV
description: PV mounted on buoyant structures over water; relevant to offshore/nearshore facilities where land is unavailable. Water cooling can improve yield; salt-water installations need corrosion resistance, wave/wind design and robust anchoring. Primary source: https://www.sungrowpower.com/en/floating-pv-system

specifications.basis: Sungrow floating PV page: 'With Over 4GW of Floating PV Application'; No.1 global market share stated; 290+ patents
Sungrow FPV case: world's largest floating PV project at a hydroelectric power station, Cirata, Indonesia, reservoir, 192 MW
Wikipedia floating solar: grew from 3 GW in 2020 to 13 GW in 2022; World Bank estimates >4,000 GW technical capacity at 10% coverage of 6,600 large water bodies

specifications.metric: FPV energy-yield gain from water cooling
specifications.basis: Wikipedia floating solar 'cooling effect of the water ... leads to an energy gain that ranges from 5% to 15%'
Wikipedia floating solar: 'installation was about 10-25% higher in 2023', attributed mainly to anchoring (NREL researcher)
Wikipedia: Swimsol installed world's first offshore floating solar PV at sea, 15 kWp pilot in Maldives with TU Wien and Fraunhofer; 2019 Oceans of Energy first open rough-sea North Sea farm
